about: Licence policy for scripts/licence_scan.py --check (F3). The project itself is proprietary (LICENSE); `first_party` lists its own packages, which must declare one of `first_party_licences`. `allowed`: SPDX ids a dependency may carry without review. `exceptions`: packages whose copyleft, proprietary or unknown licence was reviewed. Each records the licence it was reviewed under (a change fails the check) and why it is acceptable; `notice` is the text NOTICE carries for it; `owner_decision: true` marks an exception that is in place only so CI stays green and still needs the owner's sign-off; `decision` records one the owner made (status, by, date, terms). An approved GPL-family exception must carry, in `notice`, the licence-text URL and "source shipped in image at /usr/share/doc/datawrap/third-party-source" (Dockerfile.api ships the corresponding source), as binary distribution requires. A new copyleft or unknown dependency fails CI until it is reviewed here.

pypi:certifi.why: Weak, file-level copyleft. Used unmodified as a library (CA bundle for requests/httpx/snowflake). Obligation: keep its notices and say where its source is.

pypi:orjson.why: Pulled in by trino. Weak, file-level copyleft (MPL-2.0 parts). Used unmodified as a library.
pypi:orjson.notice: MPL-2.0 AND (Apache-2.0 OR MIT), used unmodified. Source: https://github.com/ijl/orjson

pypi:paramiko.why: SFTP connector. LGPL library used unmodified and loaded as a separate, user-replaceable Python package. Redistributing it in the API image needs its licence text and source location.
pypi:paramiko.notice: LGPL-2.1, used unmodified as a separately replaceable library (you may replace it with a modified version). Licence text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.html (also in the package's dist-info). Corresponding source shipped in image at /usr/share/doc/datawrap/third-party-source/ (paramiko-<installed version>.tar.gz, SHA256SUMS). Upstream: https://github.com/paramiko/paramiko

pypi:psycopg2-binary.why: PostgreSQL connector. LGPL-3.0 with exceptions. Used unmodified as a separate library. The binary wheel bundles libpq (PostgreSQL Licence) and OpenSSL.
pypi:psycopg2-binary.notice: LGPL-3.0 with the psycopg2 exceptions, used unmodified as a separately replaceable library (you may replace it with a modified version); the wheel bundles libpq (PostgreSQL Licence) and OpenSSL (Apache-2.0). Licence text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html (also in the package's dist-info). Corresponding source shipped in image at /usr/share/doc/datawrap/third-party-source/ (psycopg2-<installed version>.tar.gz, SHA256SUMS). Upstream: https://github.com/psycopg/psycopg2

pypi:pymssql.why: SQL Server fallback driver. LGPL-2.1. Used unmodified as a separate library. The wheel bundles FreeTDS (LGPL).
pypi:pymssql.notice: LGPL-2.1, used unmodified as a separately replaceable library (you may replace it with a modified version); the wheel links FreeTDS (LGPL-2.0) statically. Licence text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.html (also in the package's dist-info). Corresponding source shipped in image at /usr/share/doc/datawrap/third-party-source/ (pymssql-<installed version>.tar.gz and freetds-<linked version>.tar.gz, SHA256SUMS). Upstream: https://github.com/pymssql/pymssql and https://www.freetds.org

pypi:pypdfium2.why: PDF rendering. The bindings are BSD-3-Clause / Apache-2.0. The bundled PDFium binary carries the licences of its own dependencies (FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, OpenJPEG, LittleCMS, zlib, ICU, abseil, ...), which ship in the wheel's licence folder. All are permissive.
pypi:pypdfium2.notice: BSD-3-Clause / Apache-2.0; the bundled PDFium binary's third-party licences ship in the wheel (pypdfium2 *.dist-info/licenses). Source: https://github.com/pypdfium2-team/pypdfium2

pypi:hypothesis.why: Test tool only (requirements-dev.txt). Not in the production image, so not distributed.
